'''Jarl Narvis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who lived during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Jarl was married to [[Gille Narvis]], and their daughter was [[Kalee Narvis]]. He and Gille owned the arms company [[Legal Arms Ltd.]], and Jarl was [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] of the company's ship, ''[[Aggressive Negotiation]]''. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], he flew it to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] to deliver some weapons for the [[Cularin Militia]]. However, it was attacked and boarded by a [[Thaereian military]] patrol and they killed Jarl.
